notes.title: INFERIUS New Announcement Trailer!
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Announcement Trailer Unleashed![/b][/h1][p]After some long hellish nights, we're excited to show off our now Announcement Trailer for INFERIUS![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ii4rV05xUDk;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][i]“I've seen many Pilgrims fall, but you... you shall fly!”[/i][/h3][p] [/p][h1][b]Steam Page Gets a Makeover[/b][/h1][p]As we enter the final phases of development, we have completely revamped the visuals on our Steam page to better reflect our current quality and stage of development.[/p][p][/p][p]As development continues, we'll continue to showcase new work on the Steampage![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705325/64ea99602a541802da23302a236c89c922df2c69.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]If you can make it to GamesCom come check us out![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/INFERIUS"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/bAFV8azZx3" style="button" buttoncolor="#737373"]Join our Discord Community[/url]
[/p][h3]The descent through the Inferno begins soon. Will you survive?[/h3]

notes.title: INFERIUS at Gamecon Canada 2025
notes.content:
[p]Last week, we had the incredible opportunity to have a booth at GCC 2025! [/p][p][/p][p]We sneaked in a small [b]sneak peek[/b] of INFERIUS, and some of the cool in-progress development of the game and art! We also handed out numerous stickers featuring some of the creatures from the game and had many nerdy conversations with people from all across the industry.[/p][p][/p][p]We are beyond excited to share some upcoming news soon!![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who came by, you all made the event so worthwhile![/p][p]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/Inferius?utm_source=SteamEventPost_GCC2025" style="button"]INFERIUS is available to Wishlist on Steam![/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705325/0902c28bdf665d7c97bd3c4f6c782ae200de4b59.png"][/img][/p][p]We are also starting to get more active on our mailing list for development updates![/p][p][url="https://mailchi.mp/96882b530b3e/lucid-rain-studios-emailing-list-signup"]Sign up for updates and to register for free playtests![/url][/p]

notes.title: The "WHAT THE F*** IS THAT" award
notes.content:
INFERIUS was selected to participate in the first-ever TGAGWCAGA Awards Show. 

TGAGWCAGA is a brand new showcase designed to spotlight incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention—while also poking a bit of fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

All games showcased will be on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45328769/sale/TGAGWCAGA]Steam sale event[/url]

Go watch the showcase on the [url=https://youtu.be/prrLRWxntgg?t=7538&si=5gY9pcn02RUkHF8o]TGAGWCAGA YouTube page[/url] and support some exceptional upcoming & released indie games!

notes.title: Lucid Rain Studios Featured on All Ages of Geek Podcast! 🎙️
notes.content:
[h1]Lucid Rain Studios Featured on All Ages of Geek Podcast![/h1]

We had the incredible opportunity to chat with All Ages of Geek about INFERIUS and our journey as an indie game studio. Here’s a sneak peek of what we covered:

[list]
[*] The inspiration behind INFERIUS, blending Dante’s Divine Comedy and Lovecraftian horror.
Unique gameplay features: Tarot deckbuilding, sanity mechanics, and navigating the nine levels of the Inferno.
[*] Challenges and triumphs of being an indie studio, from managing scope to fostering creativity.
[*] How we celebrate milestones, encourage teamwork, and maintain morale during tough phases.
[/list]

Listen to the full podcast to dive deep into the world of INFERIUS and learn more about Lucid Rain Studios.

🎧 Catch the episode on All Ages of Geek's Youtube Channel!
[previewyoutube=6quaSUVz-_o;full][/previewyoutube]

📌 Don’t forget to wishlist INFERIUS on Steam and join the conversation in our Discord community.

[url=https://discord.gg/bAFV8azZx3]Join Our Discord[/url] | [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/Inferius?utm_source=steamannouncement]Wishlist INFERIUS on Steam[/url]

Thank you for supporting our journey into the depths of the Inferno!
